hook_text: The first time I couldn't get up the ladder, I told my apprentice my back went out. [primary text]
persona_inferred: inferred: 50s tradesman whose knees and hands are failing and who hides it from his crew

visual_hook: kitchen windowsill still life: ibuprofen bottle, coffee mug, worn leather work gloves; no text
sutherland_lens: inferred: makes the invisible visible (the hidden cost of a body worn down by work) for a proud tradesman; fits the persona, but the product is a joint supplement, not the wallet category.
works: first-person confession opens on a concrete ladder moment; the ibuprofen and gloves image names the persona without any text.
weak: the story is long and the product arrives late; landing page is a capsule product page with health claims, a policy-sensitive area; the narrator story is unverified.

hook_text: Our best selling minimalist wallet since its launch this year! [card primary text]
